rec.name: PDP Gallery Featured Video Play Button (with GIF/animated thumbnail)

what.text: A round or square video play button overlaid on the product gallery's main image (top-right in the screenshot). It opens a featured product video. The thumbnail inside the button can be a still image or an animated GIF, so the button shows motion before it is clicked. The button has a slight drop shadow and is slightly larger than the default so it stands out. It can be shown on the first gallery image only or on all images.

why.text: Motion draws the eye, so the button feels dynamic and invites a click. A video shows the product in use, its size and its features better than static photos, which reduces uncertainty before purchase. The shadow and larger size raise the button's visual weight so shoppers notice it. Showing it on the first image only keeps the gallery clean and avoids repeating the call to action.

how.text: Add a video play button to the PDP gallery theme section. Store the video in a product metafield ('Featured video', File type) and the cover in a second metafield ('Featured video thumbnail', File type, which accepts GIF). The theme setting 'Video Play Button' controls Position, 'Fixing the video' (display only on first image / on all images) and Format (Circle / Square). Style the button with a soft box-shadow and a larger size. Clicking it opens the video in a popup. If no cover is uploaded, the video itself should play muted as the button preview. To remove a video, use the metafield's 'Clear' action. In the German admin this is mistranslated as 'transparent'.

items: Fixing the video: Display the video only on first image / Display the video on all images
Product metafield: Featured video thumbnail (image or GIF file)

dependencies.text: Product metafields 'Featured video' (File) and 'Featured video thumbnail' (File, GIF or image). Requires a theme with a gallery video section and a popup/modal component. The screenshot shows a Sectionfy-based theme. Video files should be compressed and GIFs kept small, because both affect page speed.

items: PDP add-to-cart rate for products with vs. without video
Video play rate and watch time
Conversion rate and revenue per visitor on PDP
Page load speed (LCP) impact of the GIF or video thumbnail

images.caption: Theme editor: round video play button with a thumbnail at the top-right of the main product image. The 'Video Play Button' settings show Position, 'Display the video only on first image / on all images' and Format (Circle / Square).
Product metafields in Shopify admin: 'Featured video' file with Change / Clear actions, and 'Featured video thumbnail' holding a GIF.
